notes: HW exposure/gain via i2c (exp~1600, b6=3); mild software grade on top. This software_preview is a point-in-time calibration for whatever room lighting was present at approved_at — it is NOT auto-adjusting (auto.enabled is unused dead code, see camera_preview.py's AutoLookState, which nothing in camera-stream-server.py's hot path calls). If the picture looks over/under-exposed after a fresh install or once lighting changes, re-tune live at http://<tablet-ip>:17824/tuner and click Save (POST /api/look) — no restart needed.
